method: CHROMIUM='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' CHROMIUM_HEADLESS=0 SMOKE_ENTRY=responsiveness npm run test:browser; headed Chrome brought to front; independent CDP pointer dispatch every 20 ms while app JS can block. Five-minute 48 kHz stereo PCM16 WAV generated before observation. No autoplay bypass.

environment.device: Previous Task 006 inventory: MacBook Air Mac15,12 / M3 / 8 GB; hardware not re-inventoried
environment.refreshRate: unverified physical display; rAF intervals observed only

limits: Small sequential samples, variable startup/JIT/GC/host load; no latency ceiling or statistical claim.

Post-context clicks include only trusted events timestamped after constructor return. Post-context timer/frame gaps exclude intervals starting before constructor return; they cannot quantify the contiguous startup stall. See overall firstPlay gaps for that.
First Play is programmatic button.click() inside the trusted probe handler with same-origin transient activation; the separate playback suite checks direct trusted Play.
Phase elapsed time is polled at 10 ms; each observation also includes a trailing 100 ms to catch delayed input/frames.
rAF gaps are not physical dropped-frame measurements. No physical audio/display sync, native memory, reclamation, or five-minute drift evidence.
Temporary control changed only the adapter preparation call to Promise.resolve(copyPlaybackBuffer(...)); final source restored before checks.

finalHeadlessPlaybackRegression.caveat: Isolated copyPlaybackBuffer timing is the unchanged synchronous offline helper; UI first Play exercises the chunked implementation. Heap numbers do not measure native memory/reclamation.
